entries.definition: Self-giving covenant allegiance embodied, for those under God's authority, in commandment-keeping. Obedience without love can be empty sacrifice, but claimed love that persistently refuses His commands is false — “this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments”.
entries.common_view: Commonly taught: self-giving devotion or benevolence toward God and neighbor, with obedience as its necessary fruit and evidence rather than love's defining form.
entries.citations: (John 14:15; 1 Cor 13:3; 1 John 4:8-10; 5:3; 2 John 4-6; Rom 13:10) · see Love, Knowing, Faith & Belief, ch. 6
